# Get all phone contacts with relationship "friend"
phone_token = phone_login['access_token']
all_friends = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    contacts = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship='friend', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not contacts:
        break
    all_friends.extend(contacts)
    if len(contacts) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Number of phone friends: {len(all_friends)}")
for c in all_friends:
    print(c)
